Berry Balanced.description: Contestants must traverse across a series of balance beams to retrieve an object then head back to deposit it

Big Top Drop.description: Aim balls down a tube in a predetermined amount of time or balls

Binary Bridge.description: Try to guess the correct path of tiles to reach the end.

Bowlerina.description: Spin around to lower a barrier to roll down a set of pins.

Build the Bridge.description: Build a bridge using two planks of different length

Carnival Quick Shot.description: Contestants must roll a number of balls on the flat platform and/or knock the balls off of the platform in the fastest time.

Cover Your Days.description: Guess what day an event occurred.

Fitting In.description: Take a series of shapes and fit them into a certain shape

Getting Loopy.description: View a certain amount of video, then answer questions about them.

Hide and Seek.description: Figure out which of the given hiding spots is safe to hide at to avoid elimination.

Hourglass.description: Stack objects/solve a puzzle while refilling their timer.

In The Balance.description: Competitors compete to balance a set of objects without touching the ground

Kaitlyn's Puzzle.description: Pass the puzzle pieces through a barrier and complete it on the other side in the allotted time, or gather all the puzzle pieces and complete it in the fastest time.

Knockout.description: Look at a picture, buzz in first, and answer correctly.

Laser Maze.description: Navigate through a series of lasers while guiding an object to the finish.

Living Art.description: Houseguests race to find discrepancies in artwork or imagery and tape in the correct answer on their podium.

Microbrews.description: Stack tiny objects in a vertical formation by using oversized tweezers.

Niagara Balls.description: Get a specific number of colored balls into your container the quickest.

OTEV.description: A competition where houseguests listen to a riddle and search for an answer before they are the last one to return.

Only One Path.description: Try to find the correct path and reach the buzzer before the time limit

Perfect Shot.description: Contestants must roll a ball down a ramp of obstacles to either land it in a box or get the highest point value.

Pipeline.description: Build a pipeline that passes through each connector piece to the other podium.

Pyramid.description: A group of houseguests hold onto ropes that hold the base of a pyramid. Each houseguest takes turns stacking & holding. If the tower falls, the team must restart.

Roll It Down.description: Roll balls down a winding track and attempt to land it in one of the holes.

Seesaw.description: Balance on a large seesaw to transport balls from one end to the other.

Sequence Explosion.description: A competition where houseguests watch a sequence of patterns to complete a task.

Shootout.description: Roll/hit/shoot a ball/arrow to get the highest point value.

Slippery Slope.description: Collect a product from a bucket, slide down your lane and put it in another container to retrieve a ball.

Starting Lineup.description: Complete the correct houseguest puzzle by finding out who is missing from the lineup

The Wall.description: Hang on to a moving wall as long as you can.

To Drink or to Bluff.description: Houseguests guess who drank the "poisoned" drink.

Tower of Hanoi.description: Rearrange disc so that they are matching and are in order.

What Did They Just Do?.description: Watch a short performance and then answer questions.

What The Bleep?.description: Try to guess what the bleeped out word or phrase is said in the clip.

What's The Hold Up.description: By using a long flexible structure, hold up object against a plaque.

Zingbot Competition.description: A themed competition where the Houseguests compete to The Zingbot's need.

extra.Description: Hidden throughout the house were sticks of "BB-tonium". Twelve sticks have Enzo's correct corresponding number on the screen. The first twelve houseguests that would arrive back with the correct stick would advance to the Immunity Competitions.

Each houseguest was given a mobile hanging structure and various objects with different weights. The first houseguest to balance all the objects, hit their buzzer, and have the objects hold for ten seconds would win Immunity for the week.

Before each houseguest was a maze from one platform to the other. In order to get from one to the other, each houseguest must use two planks to solve their maze puzzle. The first houseguest to cross the maze would win Immunity for the week.

In front of each houseguest was three buttons with three different phases. During each round, the houseguests must listen to the taped sequence and count which phrase was said the most. The houseguest who pressed the incorrect button or the slowest correct push would be eliminated. The last remaining houseguest would win Immunity for the week.

The three reality icons were separated by the three groups that "entered" them into the game. Each group of new houseguests would each hold a rope that would balance a platform in the middle. The reality icon would create a flame puzzle onto of that platform. The first icon to correctly solve and balance the puzzle would win HOH.

Each houseguest is given a set of pipes and various rings. Throughout the course each houseguest must create a path from one side of the course to the other passing through all the rings. The first houseguest to pass through all the rings will win the Veto.

Throughout the arena, the different screens will be flashing images of the houseguests in different wigs. The each competing houseguest would need to figure out which of the houseguests in the photos appears the most. The first houseguest to lock in the correct answer the quickest wins safety from the night's eviction.

In front of the houseguests is a large shuffleboard with corresponding numbers to different positions on the board. Each round, the houseguests would group up in pairs to compete for the round. In each round, a different rule on how the scoring system would work to determine the winners of each round. The final houseguest survive all the rounds would win HOH.
Inside the Time Capsule, press a button to randomly collect a punishment or reward.

Scattered throughout the backyard are various puzzle pieces for each houseguest's puzzle. The first houseguest to assemble their puzzle on the their puzzle board in the correct way and press their buzzer would win the Veto

In front of each houseguest is a set of four spools of different shaped treasures. Each treasure must be moved so each spool has three of a kind of each treasure on it. The houseguests are not allowed to set any treasures on the ground and must add it to a spool before picking up another one. The first houseguest to complete the puzzle would win safety from the night's eviction.

Before the competition, a wrestling match would take place. The objective for each houseguest is to memorize aspects of the match. Afterwards, each houseguest competed in a true/false booth competition about the match elements. The one houseguests who corrected answered the most questions would win HOH.
Inside the Time Capsule, press a button to randomly collect a punishment or reward.

In a twist on the classic competition Bowlerina, each houseguest will spin on a pickle and then will use a large pickle shaped paddle to hit balls towards a wall. On the wall there are different slots with different point values. The houseguest that collects the most points in their head to head matchup wins the round, with the winner of the final round winning the Power of Veto.

In front of each houseguest is a Jenga-like structure made up of videotapes on thin platforms. The object for each houseguest is to remove a videotape, without the structure falling, and return it to the start line. The houseguest to collect the most tapes in two minutes without their tower falling would win safety from the night's eviction.

The houseguests are transported inside a model replica of a house to study for clues. After a brief study session, the houseguests would be asked a question about a certain item in each room such as a clock. In order to pass the round, the houseguests would have to hide in a room that would not have that object, or they would be eliminated. The last remaining houseguest would win HOH.
Inside the Time Capsule, press a button to randomly collect a punishment or reward.

Among each houseguest is two glasses of wine, one red and one white. One of those two glasses is marked as "poisoned". The object of the game is to select another houseguest and convince them to drink from the poisonous glass while you drink from the safe glass. If a houseguest drinks the poison twice, they are eliminated. The last houseguest remaining would win the Veto.

In front of each houseguest is pieces to a Paw Patrol themed puzzle. The objective is to construct the two level puzzle and hit the buzzer the fastest. The first houseguest to do so would win safety from the night's eviction.

Each houseguest is up on the iconic wall hanging on to a bar on top of the wall that hangs in front of each houseguest. During random intervals, the wall would be tipped forward and back with slime shot between moving. The last houseguest to stay up on the wall would win HOH.
Inside the Time Capsule, press a button to randomly collect a punishment or reward.

In front of each houseguest is a set of tiles that light up when stepped on. When stepping on each tile, it will either turn red or green. Green means the houseguest can advance, and red would indicate an incorrect step and head back to the beginning. The set of tiles that the houseguests are stepping on are not shown to the houseguests beforehand so the houseguest must experiment to figure out which tiles are correct and which are incorrect while remembering the pattern when it resets. The first houseguest to solve their tile puzzle and make it to the end wins their match. After all the matches, the remaining houseguest would win the veto.

In front of each houseguest is a two-way ramp that has a carpet platform on the top. The objective for each houseguest is to land five balls on top of the platform from either side of the two-way ramp. Once that was completed, each houseguest must use a different set of balls to knock all five balls off. The first to knock their five balls off the platform would win safety from the night's eviction.

In a knockout style competition, two houseguests are viewing a screen of bugs. Each houseguest must count the bugs and press the button of the that has the most bugs. If the houseguest is correct, they advance and select the next two houseguests to face-off. If they are not correct, they are eliminated and their opponent gets to select the next two houseguest. The last houseguest remaining after all of the rounds would win HOH.
Inside the Time Capsule, press a button to randomly collect a punishment or reward.
